paragraphs.text: Bolar (BOH-lar ) was a shaman of an unknown species living in the city of Kjeld during the Ice Age of Dominaria .

Bolar traveled to Dominaria from an unknown plane within the Shard of the Twelve Worlds and decided to settle on the plane. He was part of Sir Zaraya 's band to help the Marked Ones and befriended them during the mission. He recognized the planeswalker Kristina of the Woods when she appeared for Freyalise ’s World Spell .
Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering vol. 2 states that Bolar was an "aspiring Planeswalker " from a plane other than Dominaria. This may imply he was an ember .
